title: Tailnet Home
_comment_notes_group: Optional: put pages from notes/ into this tag's group instead of a separate Notes group.
_comment_live: Optional per service: `live` fetches a JSON URL on every scan and shows the lines in `show` on the tile back. `{path.to.value}` or `{value:.0f}` (Python format) pick values; `root` picks a sub-object first; $VARS in url/headers come from the environment.
_comment_start: Optional: pin only these tiles to the Start screen, in this order (service, bookmark or note names; {"name": "Jellyfin", "size": "w"} for s/m/w). Everything else stays in the A–Z list. Leave out to show everything. `accent` sets the phone tile color: cobalt, emerald, crimson, teal, magenta, orange, indigo, brown, mauve, violet, olive.
_comment: Copy to services.json (git-ignored) and edit. `device` is the MagicDNS short name. Give a full `url`, or just `port`/`path`/`scheme` and scan.py builds the address from the device's Tailscale IP (MagicDNS name for https). `lang`: "en" or "zh"; empty means English unless the viewer switches. Icons are picked from the name; set `glyph` to override: ledger, coin, book, reader, photo, cloud, doc, pen, git, code, car, chart, db, server, spark, home, globe.
_comment_hide: URLs found by `tailscale serve` or --probe that you don't want listed.
_comment_bookmarks: Links outside the tailnet, shown in their own section.
